company_description:
Corvale Mobility is a privately held transportation and software company headquartered in Kraków, Poland. It operates long-distance bus services and a growing passenger-rail network across Central Europe, offering online booking, trip tracking and travel extras. Its asset-light model combines regional operating partners with Corvale’s own booking platform, network planning and brand. The company is expanding its rail services and prioritising data and machine learning to improve its platform.

Founded by transport and software professionals, Corvale remains founder-led and describes itself as engineering-led. Teams take end-to-end ownership of their systems, work collaboratively to solve problems and are encouraged to bring forward new ideas. Its stated values—“Lead, Shape, Own, Enjoy the journey”—reflect initiative, ownership and personal development. The company also emphasises shared goals across international teams, sustainability as part of growth, and technology as a way to change how people travel.

Corvale has received workplace culture awards in areas including innovation, flexibility, purpose and values, professional development and employee appreciation. It describes its culture as collaborative, fast-moving and open, and says it acts on employee feedback. Depending on the role, work arrangements may include hybrid working or independent contracting; employees can also receive travel benefits on Corvale’s network.
